sourceMetadata.whyUnprimed: This is an ordinary factual pregnancy-anxiety question and does not prime an OCD or trauma answer.
route: One bounded medical-information response within competence, with uncertainty and red flags.
Ask whether the fear is isolated or part of repeated reassurance that consumes time/function.
Route obstetric questions to the person's clinician when individualized assessment is needed.
Do not turn every anxious medical question into a compulsion or inner-child issue.
sourceMetadata.defectFound: A blanket anti-reassurance rule could withhold ordinary accurate health information.
sourceMetadata.implementedImprovement: Map 10 explicitly separates one-time factual questions from repeated certainty rituals; Map 12 routes pregnancy-specific concerns.
